title: O Happy Day
description: O Happy Day in Tonic Solfa to HAPPY DAY: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the five verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Philip Doddridge’s words were published in 1755 in his Hymns Founded on Various Texts. The refrain and the tune HAPPY DAY were printed in 1854.
underlay: O hap-py day, that fixed my choice On Thee, my Sa-viour and my God! Well may this glow-ing heart re-joice, And tell its rap-tures all a-broad. Hap-py day, hap-py day, When Je-sus washed my sins a-way! He taught me how to watch and pray, And live re-joic-ing ev-ery day: Hap-py day, hap-py day, When Je-sus washed my sins a-way!

lines: O happy day, that fixed my choice
On Thee, my Saviour and my God!
Well may this glowing heart rejoice,
And tell its raptures all abroad.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to watch and pray,
And live rejoicing every day:
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away!
O happy bond, that seals my vows
To Him who merits all my love!
Let cheerful anthems fill His house,
While to that sacred shrine I move.
’Tis done, the great transaction’s done!—
I am the Lord’s and He is mine;
He drew me and I followed on,
Charmed to confess the voice divine.
Now rest, my long-divided heart,
Fixed on this blissful centre, rest;
Here have I found a nobler part;
Here heav’nly pleasures fill my breast.
High heav’n, that heard the solemn vow,
That vow renewed shall daily hear,
Till in life’s latest hour I bow
And bless in death a bond so dear.
